  JOIN product_category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
  JOIN vw_pedidos_validos v ON v.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN order_payments op ON op.order_id = v.order_id
  WHERE op.payment_type != 'not_defined' GROUP BY oi.order_id, t.product_category_name_english
), pp2 AS (
  SELECT categoria, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS pedidos, SUM(CASE WHEN cuotas > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pagados_a_plazos

)

FROM pp2 ORDER BY pct_a_plazos DESC LIMIT 1
